dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Have you had a chat with Wolfy? We talked for a while, and he told me a lot of interesting things.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Plus, he's so furry! Not like Lumi...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no, no! I shouldn't compare. They're both wonderful in their own ways!
